info.title: hs sys contract
info.description: The `hs sys` words as an API. One path segment is one argv word. A tsv output is one row per line, fields separated by tabs, an empty field written -. Machine lines never change shape. Secrets go on stdin only. HS_CALLER (cli, web, job, timer, test) tells the script who calls. Plan and start exit 0 (allowed), 1 (refused) or 2 (something is missing). Generated by scripts/openapi-gen.py from scripts/lib/registry.tsv and docs/api/sys.toml; never edit by hand. Open: whether a change to a described shape bumps scripts/lib/api-level is not decided; for now it does not.
